name: Coulommier
source:
One of the 3 ladies working at Pub Chambertin. She usually butts into conversations, but sometimes you can't blame her.

As a hedonist and a fuckbuddy, she is a little exhausting. Is her no-strings-attached personality the secret behind her popularity?
